steps.content: [Consciousness World: Ceto's Life Flashing Before Her Eyes]

steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: You tired?

A reply catches in Ceto's throat, emerging as silence. From the gloom before her, a figure solidifies. It's Lia, clad in her tactical gear, her Rancor in hand. She smiles, reaching both hands toward Ceto.

steps.speaker: Lia
steps.content: Come join me and Jay. We've been sleeping beneath the Black Tide for so long... long enough to forget all the pain.
As Lia begins to fall backward, Ceto's arms snap out on instinct to catch her.

steps.speaker: Lia
steps.content: You won't have to listen to the voices of the blade anymore. See? I've become just like the monsters.
Ceto lunges forward, only to grasp at empty air. Lia's form dissolves, collapsing into a pool of contaminated sludge.
Then, Sienna's figure emerges from the shadows. The flag in her hand drips black liquid with a steady pitter-patter.

steps.speaker: Sienna
steps.content: Where did you get all these new wounds? That must hurt so much...
Sienna's gaze is heavy with concern as it traces the fresh wounds covering Ceto's body.

steps.speaker: Sienna
steps.content: You gave me the last painkiller we had... but why...

steps.speaker: Sienna
steps.content: Why does it still hurt this much?

Sienna lowers her head, staring at the gaping hole in her chest. Ceto instinctively steps back, only to bump into something solid. She turns to find Miles standing behind her, with a dozen golden cans scattered at his feet.

steps.speaker: Miles
steps.content: Hey kid, you hungry? Remember these?
He nudges a can with his boot, sending it rolling to her feet. As Ceto bends to pick it up, the can suddenly splits open in her hands, a rotting fish head tumbling out.

steps.speaker: Miles
steps.content: The "spoils" I traded my life for... they were actually rotten long before I got them.
A wave of dizziness hits as the can grows leaden in Ceto's grip. She looks up to speak, to defend his effort, but Miles's face is already melting, distorting beyond recognition.

steps.speaker: Herbert
steps.content: Milly
Herbert is pinned between crushing doors, straining for a decaying family portrait floating in the Black Tide.
In an instant, the photo morphs into a rejected transfer request to return home, stamped "DENIED."
Ceto reaches out to catch it, but she's one step late. Another familiar figure appears before her.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: The year I found you in WhiteSands... you weren't even as tall as my sword.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Everyone told me it was too dangerous to keep a child. I didn't listen. Other kids would scream at the sight of a Rancor, but you? You'd curl up next to one and sleep like a kitten.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: I thought you were our hope. So how could you... how could you leave them all to the Black Tide?
Fynn's hand closes around the Rancor at her waist.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: If that's how it's going to be, then fall in line. Don't we lighthouse keepers live and die together?
Steel shrieks against steel, sparks flying as the very space around them shudders. Fynn drives forward with terrifying strength, each blow forcing Ceto back a step.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're not Fynn...
Ceto parries "Fynn's" slash, using the momentum to pivot. She puts her entire weight into a fierce counter-thrust, driving her dagger toward the shadowy mimic.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Her last wish... was for me to live.
<color=#dg1f1f>Hahahaha... Live as what? A walking tombstone?</color>
The shadow suddenly releases its weapon, impaling itself on Ceto's blade. As Ceto looks up, its features shift into the faces of her comrades, their blood now staining her hands.
Familiar, isn't it? That helplessness. Watching your comrades die, and you can do nothing.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Get away from me! Don't you dare wear their faces. You're not worthy of their memory!

Ceto's blade cuts across the shadow's face. The phantom visage dissolves into black sludge, then reforms into a mirror image—a Ceto clad in a blood-drenched keeper's uniform, her pupils burning with the Rancor's crimson glow.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: But I am you, Ceto. The last keeper. And you are powerless! The lighthouse? DisCity? All of it is meaningless!

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: So now you want to live? You've forgotten your past. But it's okay. I'll help you remember.
[Beach] [Filter] [Young Ceto]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: This is...

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Don't recognize it? This was your first time, hahaha... Your first attempt to end it.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: You were the only one left on the island. Alone. Dragging what was left of your friend to the farthest shore to bury her...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'm sorry, Sienna, for all our arguments... I promised Fynn I'd get you all out of here...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: There's one biscuit left. You always said... don't waste anything. Do you... want it?

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Let me remind you. You ate the biscuit. Then you put your knife to your heart and lay down beside her. But the dawn came anyway. You woke up.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Hahaha... You really were born for this blade. A little blood is all it takes... to give you the strength to keep suffering.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: It's you... You're the one who's kept me alive...

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: What a perfect curse! A soul that longs for death, trapped in a body that refuses to die! You throw yourself into the hordes, praying for an end, and emerge without a scratch!
[Staircase] [Filter] [Young Ceto]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I threw you away! I sank you in the Black Tide with their blades! Why did you come back?!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're never gonna let me go, are you?

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Look how foolish you were then. This blade was forged with you on the battlefield, a final gift from your comrades. How could you possibly throw it away?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'll find a way anyway! I'll melt you down and feed your scrap to the sea monsters! I know what you are. You think wearing my face hides the stench, you damned Rancor? I know that pathetic whining anywhere!

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: That's right. I am your instinct. Your suppressed bloodlust. Your only faithful companion. And what can you do? You don't even dare to cry or laugh. Herbert taught you too well—every emotion is a liability. So you just... stopped talking.
[Inside the Lighthouse] [Filter]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Ah...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Ah... Ah!

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: You almost forgot how to make a sound! Did you think starvation was the answer? That denying this body would finally get rid of me and end it?

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: But I wanted you alive! I wanted you to see it all! Feel the sea breeze on an empty shore. Count supplies that will never be restocked. Tend a lighthouse for a city that forgot you! Waste away your meaningless existence!
[Lighthouse Top] [Filter]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Report: Lighthouse OT-N07. One keeper remaining. No abnormalities observed. I... lost consciousness from hunger. Woke up with the taste of rancid monster meat in my mouth. No memory of eating them.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Report: Lighthouse OT-N07. Rare sunshine today. Expect lighter monster activity at high tide. There are no abnormalities...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Report: Lighthouse OT-N07. Sorted through the old belongings left by the others. Nothing of use. ...No abnormalities.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: The keepers are gone. Your purpose died with them. So just end it. Isn't that what you've always wanted?
[Return to Consciousness World]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Argh—!

Without warning, the dark shadow seizes control of Ceto's knife and—with brutal force—drives the blade deep into her shoulder. The weapon then twists viciously, grinding against bone and tearing through the flesh beneath her ravaged skin.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: What a shame... The only reason I kept you alive was to feed on your despair. And now you want to live? To run away with some stray you just found? HAHAHAHAHA...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: What the hell do you want from me?!

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: What I have always wanted. Blood. Battle. I like your self-loathing, your isolation. But if you won't provide that feast... then this ends now.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: This bloodlust is the true curse of the blade. And now, I'm taking my power back...!
The shadow then forces the bloodied dagger in her hand to turn, dragging it inch by agonizing inch toward her own throat.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: You never deserved to live in the first place.
